subject: Meridian Payments — Request: multi-region DR carveout and RTO/RPO guarantees
messages:
From: Alyssa Park <ops@meridianpayments.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajesh Banerjee <rajesh@meridianpayments.com>
Date: Tue, 15 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Multi-region DR commitment request (RTO/RPO)

Hi Marissa,

Quick note from our infra and risk teams after reviewing the draft MSA: Meridian is running a payments backend that requires failover between east-us and west-eu for regulatory separation. Our security team is asking for a firm RTO of <=60 minutes for region-wide failures and RPO of <=5 minutes for session/state replication for critical merchant routes.

We understand hot-active multi-region is complex, but we need a formal position and, if necessary, a carveout or amendment with measurable SLAs and credits. Can Redwood confirm whether you can commit to those numbers, or propose a formal exception path (e.g., reserved warm standby, pre-warm windows, specific roll-forward playbooks)? We also need a written timeline and cost estimate for the standby configuration.

Can we get a proposed addendum by EOD Thursday (5/17)? We have an internal board review scheduled the following week.

Thanks,
Alyssa
Alyssa Park
Head of Infrastructure Operations
Meridian Payments

--
Attachment: none

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Park <ops@meridianpayments.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 May 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Multi-region DR commitment request (RTO/RPO)

On Tue, May 15, 2028 at 9:12 AM Alyssa Park <ops@meridianpayments.com> wrote:
> Quick note from our infra and risk teams after reviewing the draft MSA: Meridian is running a payments backend that requires failover between east-us and west-eu for regulatory separation. Our security team is asking for a firm RTO of <=60 minutes for region-wide failures and RPO of <=5 minutes for session/state replication for critical merchant routes.
>
> We understand hot-active multi-region is complex, but we need a formal position and, if necessary, a carveout or amendment with measurable SLAs and credits.

Alyssa — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. We can do a formal carveout but the specific SLA numbers you requested (RTO <= 60m, RPO <= 5m) are only achievable under an explicit dedicated/reserved configuration and with a couple of constraints:

- Dedicated warm-standby in the secondary region with pre-warmed model pools for the critical routes.
- State replication using our streaming KV-forwarding (adds RPO ~15s–5m depending on payload size and persistence guarantees).
- Canary failover procedures and runbooks exercised quarterly.
- A provisioning window: if capacity needs to be scaled beyond reserved baseline, there is a 60–180 minute provisioning window depending on instance types.

Proposal (high-level):
- Offer: Addendum A (attached draft) that defines an exception for Meridian's critical routes on a per-route basis.
- Committed availability: 99.95% for the primary region; cross-region failover target (RTO) for routes covered by Addendum A: 90–180 minutes unless Meridian purchases a fully hot-active duplicate reserved pool (see cost estimate).
- RPO: we can guarantee <=5 minutes if you enable our streaming replication and accept per-GB ingestion caps; achievable to <=60 seconds for optimized small session keys with reserved throughput.
- SLA credits: staggered credit schedule tied to measurable post-failover recovery time.

I attached a first-pass addendum (meridian-dr-addendum-draft-v1.pdf) for your legal and risk teams to review. Karthik has prepared a short cost/ops note and Jonas is on copy for commercial/contracting.

Happy to walk through specifics on a call — propose 30 minutes on Thursday 5/17 or Friday 5/18.

Best,
Marissa Cole
VP, Sales — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: meridian-dr-addendum-draft-v1.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Alyssa Park <ops@meridianpayments.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 May 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Multi-region DR commitment request (RTO/RPO) — ops notes and cost estimate

Marissa / Alyssa — adding operational detail:

1) If Meridian wants a hard <=60 minute RTO for region-wide failure across critical routes, the only practical architecture at scale is active-passive with a fully reserved warm-standby (idle capacity pre-warmed) in the secondary region. Cold start or burst scenarios cannot reliably meet 60m.

2) Cost: reserved warm standby (N GPUs matching production baseline) + pre-warm windows will carry a ~1.6–2.2x baseline monthly cost depending on instance family and regional pricing. I've attached a rough estimate (capacity-cost-estimate.xlsx).

3) RPO: our streaming replication achieves sub-minute durable replication for small session keys when you reserve throughput and avoid large batch checkpoints. For large payloads (session blobs >1MB) expect RPO to increase.

4) Operational controls we require in Addendum A:
   - Traffic scoping: specify critical routes by endpoint prefix and QPS caps per route.
   - Pre-warm schedule: maintenance windows where we re-warm model pools to keep readiness metrics in-band.
   - Acceptance criteria: runbook drills and a post-failover verification window (30 minutes) where performance metrics are validated.

If Meridian accepts the reserved standby model, we can aim for an RTO of 60–90 minutes for covered routes. Otherwise, the pragmatic SLA we can sign off in a hosted/reserved hybrid is 90–180 minutes as Marissa outlined.

I recommend we surface the cost delta to the customer with 2 options: Option A (Reserved warm-standby — RTO 60–90m), Option B (Hybrid reserved baseline + on-demand burst — RTO 90–180m).

Karthik
Sr. Director, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

Attachment: capacity-cost-estimate.xlsx

From: Rajesh Banerjee <rajesh@meridianpayments.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alyssa Park <ops@meridianpayments.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Multi-region DR commitment request (RTO/RPO)

Thanks — useful framing and appreciated the quick turnaround. We'll review the addendum and the two options with finance and risk this afternoon. Two quick clarifications:

1) For Option A (reserved warm-standby), can you confirm whether the standby instances will be billed at full reserved rate or at a reduced warm-standby rate?
2) For the runbook drills: can Redwood commit to quarterly drills and provide the drill playbook in advance to Meridian's risk team?

We aim to have internal feedback by EOD Monday 5/20 and will flag items for redlines. If there are no major gaps, we'll take you up on a 30-minute call on Monday 5/20 to finalize the addendum language.

Regards,
Rajesh
VP, Platform Engineering
Meridian Payments
